title: The Commoditization Pathways of Graphics Processing Units: A Literature-Based Analysis of Market Transformation Dynamics

contributions.purpose: 提出并验证 GPU 商品化的三条理论通路
contributions.mechanism: 基于宣称 29 篇学术/行业文献的系统综述 + 历史半导体(CPU/DRAM/NAND)先例对比
contributions.evaluation: 三通路:Performance Threshold(7.5/10 部分验证)、Software Ecosystem Barrier(8.5/10 强支持)、Market Structure Transformation(7.0/10 新兴证据)
contributions.source_quote: we validate three theoretical pathways for GPU commoditization: Performance Threshold Theory, Software Ecosystem Barrier Theory, and Market Structure Transformation Theory

contributions.purpose: 给出商品化时间线与阻力判断
contributions.mechanism: 1-10 证据评分框架 + 时间线投射
contributions.evaluation: 渐进但不可避免的 5-8 年商品化;CUDA 生态为主要阻力;DeepSeek R1 加速效率突破
contributions.source_quote: Our evidence-based framework indicates inevitable but gradual commoditization over a 5-8 year timeline, with NVIDIA's CUDA ecosystem representing the primary resistance mechanism.

notes: 非实证类:纯文献综述,无实验。数据红旗(多):Evidence Strength/Impact 的 1-10 评分(7.5/10、8.5/10 等)全为主观打分,却包装成“Statistical validation / quantitative assessment”,伪定量、无真实统计;Table1-5 各类分数无出处、凭空;声称分析“29 papers”但参考文献仅约 14 条,数量对不上;时间线数字(2026-27 云采用 25%、商品化 2/10 等)无依据。checklist AI:hypothesis[C]、design[D]、analysis[D]、writing[D](95%+ AI);统计显著性项自答 No 却声称“提供 timeline 的置信区间”(实无 CI)。desk-reject。
